citations.title: ‎Rivo: Money on Autopilot App - App Store
excerpts: Every bank lures me initially with higher interest rates and eventually drops them silently. I need to have some money to pay credit cards etc and I get very little interest because of these bad practices from banks. Rivo just solves that problem completely because now I don’t need to worry about moving my money to a higher yield account etc. It’s something I always wanted and now there is something which solves that problem!
* ### No switching banks. No weird purchases. Just extra cash.

I find it amazing how Rivo’s Autopilot lets you earn extra cash in such an easy way. The extra cash that you should be earning is just sitting idle, but with Rivo that completely changes. I just signed up and I didn’t have to change banks or anything, and from then on I wake up richer. I just want to give a big thanks to the wonderful developers who made this.

basis.reasoning: The Rivo App Store review page names two reviewers who describe using the product; these are the publicly displayed customer/reviewer names.

citations.title: FAQs | Rivo - Money Working While You Sleep
excerpts: Rivo is a technology company, not a bank. Rivo invests idle cash sitting in your bank account in short-duration U.S. Treasury Bills through Jiko Bank and Jiko Securities. It can do this in an automated way through Rivo Autopilot, and bring funds back before your bills hit. You can also choose to set thresholds for it to move through Rivo Copilot.
### How does Rivo Autopilot manage household cash?

Rivo Autopilot monitors your income, expenses, and idle cash in real time. It moves money you are not using into U.S. government-backed assets, and brings it back to your account before bills are due. Your funds are always accessible when you need them. You can withdraw your available funds through your app and it may take 1-3 business days for funds to show up in your external connected account.

Rivo is designed for any household looking to earn more on idle cash sitting in their bank account, automate bill and loan payments, eliminate idle cash drag in low-interest accounts, and move money instantly across accounts with ease.

basis.reasoning: Rivo's FAQ says Autopilot invests idle cash from existing bank accounts in short-term U.S. Treasury bills and brings funds back before bills are due; it explicitly says the product is designed for households.
